entities.name: PMID:25099744
observations: Longitudinal SEARCH cohort study of 1,142 youth with incident type 1 diabetes and at least two fasting lipid measures over two years.
BMI z-score changes were associated with favorable HDL-C and triglyceride changes only; associations varied by baseline BMI z-score, with greater improvement at higher baseline adiposity.
All measured lipid levels except LDL-C increased over follow-up; authors characterized weight loss as an effective but limited dyslipidemia strategy.
